title: My trades row
description: One set of take-profit and stop-loss that is not a bot's, as the `my-trades` topic carries it (decision 0011 §3; the panel's list is P15): on a futures position (`subject` position, following it as it changes) or on an order placed by gcx (`subject` order, the order's id). Rows stay after they end; `status` says how. Mirrors src/runtime/exits/trades.ts (TradeRow).

id.description: The exits' id: `x1`, ... on a position; the order's id on an order. The `exits.*` routes take it.

removed.description: Added 2026-10-10 (0003b amendment 3 d1, rulings 339 and 413.3): the row's account is being removed from gcx or was removed with its trading history kept; the row takes no action. Absent otherwise.

account.description: Added 2026-10-10 (0003b amendment 3 d1): with `removed`, the account's name (shown "<name> (Account removed)"), since its row in the accounts list is gone.

size.description: What the exits still cover: the position as built from fills, or what the order filled less what its exits sold.

entry.description: The position's entry, or the order's average fill; absent before anything filled.

id.description: The leg as an order (`x1/tp1`, `x1/sl`): the orders topic and the order routes know it.

index.description: The target's place, 0 first; 0 for the stop-loss.

level.description: The limit price, the trigger, or a trailing leg's stop now.

reason.description: How a closed leg ended: `filled`, `oco` (another leg or the position's end closed it), `cancelled`, `position-reversed`, ...

realizedPnl.description: The exits' own fills against the entry they closed (the venue's closedPnl is never used), net of their fees and, on an order, its fee share.

funding.description: Paid negative. A position's exits take each payment whole; an order's take usdc × q ÷ szi.

status.description: `waiting`: the order has not filled yet. `repair`: a leg needs a person, or the exchange shows the coin flat on two reads (`reason` venue-flat).

reason.description: Done: `filled`, `closed` (the position closed by a gcx order), `closed-outside`, `reversed`, `liquidated`, `cancelled`. Repair: `venue-flat` or the leg's repair reason.

following.description: Exits on a position that follow it (shown "following position").
